name: Pier 7 Warehouse, Bay 3
requires_text: Pier 7 leases bays to registered companies only.
agent_line: Pier 7 lettings: "Bay 3 is yours. Racking's up, the packing bench is by the office, and the forklift keys stay on the hook."
blurb: A bay on Pier 7 with a loading dock, pallet racking and a packing bench. Once it is yours, your stock can be delivered here and orders packed on the spot. The rent is due whether the racking is full or not.
